text: Agent: Good morning, I am calling about our new savings plan with 7 percent annual returns. Would you like to hear the details? Customer: Yes, that sounds exactly like what I need. Please sign me up today and send over the paperwork.

Agent: We have a pre-approved credit limit of five lakhs on our platinum card. Shall I proceed with the application? Customer: Absolutely, go ahead. I have been waiting for this offer. What documents do you need from me?

Agent: Our family health cover starts at nine hundred rupees a month for full hospitalization benefits. Customer: That is very reasonable. I want to enroll my whole family. Schedule a follow-up call tomorrow morning to complete it.

Agent: The home loan rate is currently 8.4 percent for salaried applicants with instant approval. Customer: Great, I am already comparing offers and yours is the best. Please start my application right now.

Agent: This mutual fund scheme has beaten its benchmark for six straight years. Can I send you the factsheet? Customer: Yes please, and I would like to invest fifty thousand this week itself. Tell me the exact next steps.
Agent: We are offering zero-balance salary accounts with free insurance bundled in. Customer: Perfect timing, I am switching jobs next month. Open one for me and link it to my new payroll.
Agent: The recurring deposit ladder gives you liquidity every six months with higher slab rates. Customer: I love that structure. Put me down for twenty thousand a month starting this cycle.
Agent: Shall I book a branch appointment for Thursday to finish your KYC? Customer: Yes, Thursday at eleven works perfectly. I will bring my Aadhaar and salary slips along.
Agent: Our term insurance plan covers up to one crore at very low premiums. Customer: No, I am not interested at all. Please do not pitch this to me again.
Agent: Would you consider consolidating your loans with our balance transfer offer? Customer: Definitely not. I am happy with my current bank and I will not be switching.
Agent: This credit card gives five percent cashback on all fuel purchases. Customer: No need, I already carry two cards and I do not want another one. Goodbye.
Agent: The child education plan guarantees payouts at every milestone year. Customer: We have already bought a similar policy elsewhere. There is no point continuing this conversation.
Agent: Can I interest you in our new pension scheme with monthly payouts after sixty? Customer: No. I never invest in pension products and that will not change.
Agent: Our gold loan disburses within thirty minutes at low interest. Customer: I do not need a loan of any kind. Please close my inquiry from your side.
Agent: A free demat account with zero brokerage for the first year, shall I open one? Customer: Not interested. I trade nowhere and I do not plan to start.
Agent: The festival offer doubles your reward points till month end. Customer: Offers do not change anything for me. Take my number off your calling list for these pitches.
Agent: Our recurring deposit rates just went up across all slabs. Would you like to invest? Customer: Thank you for the information. I will contact you if I decide to proceed.
Agent: I can walk you through the card benefits in just two minutes. Customer: That is very kind, but I am in the middle of something. Perhaps some other time.
Agent: The insurance rider covers critical illness at a small extra premium. Customer: Sounds nice, I will think about it and let you know if I need anything.
Agent: Shall I send an executive to your office with the loan documents? Customer: No need for a visit right now. If anything changes on my side, you will be the first to know.
Agent: This fund has a limited-period entry bonus for new investors. Customer: I appreciate you telling me. Let me discuss it at home and I will get back if it suits us.
Agent: Would a Saturday appointment make it easier to complete your KYC? Customer: Thanks, but my weekends are fully packed these days. I will reach out whenever I am free.
Agent: Your pre-approved limit is waiting, it only takes five minutes on this call. Customer: That is good to know. I will keep it in mind and decide later at my own pace.
Agent: Many customers in your profile have already taken this pension plan. Customer: Glad to hear that. For now I will pass, but thanks for thinking of me.
Agent: I can hold this festival rate for you till Friday if you confirm today. Customer: Please do not hold anything on my account. I will come back only if I am genuinely interested.
Agent: The new savings account comes with free movie tickets every month. Customer: Ha, tempting, but I will stick to my current account for now. Thanks anyway.
Agent: Can we complete your application this week itself? Customer: Not this week, I am travelling for work. Try me next month when things settle down.
Agent: The loan disbursal can happen before the festival season. Customer: My daughter's wedding is eating all my funds right now. Ask me again after December.
Agent: Shall we lock this interest rate before the policy review? Customer: I cannot decide anything before my appraisal cycle ends. Let us talk in the next quarter.
Agent: When would be a good time to take this forward? Customer: Tuesday at three in the afternoon works for me. Call me then and we will finish the formalities.
Agent: This offer expires at month end, should I extend it for you? Customer: I am too tied up with quarter closing to look at this. Maybe revisit it later.
Agent: A quick five-minute verification is all that remains in your file. Customer: Not today, I have back-to-back meetings. I will call the helpline myself when I get time.
Agent: Would you like me to pause and call back in the evening? Customer: Yes, call me after seven tonight. I am genuinely interested but mornings are impossible for me.
Agent: Your documents are pending since last month, shall I close the file? Customer: Do not close it yet. Give me two more weeks, I am arranging the papers slowly.
Agent: So shall I go ahead and open the account for you? Customer: I really like the product, but honestly I cannot afford another commitment this year. Let us leave it there.
Agent: The premium is only two thousand a month, very affordable. Customer: The price is fine, but my wife handles all insurance decisions and she has said no already.
Agent: Would you recommend this card to your colleagues as well? Customer: The rewards are excellent, no doubt, but the joining fee is a dealbreaker for me personally.
Agent: Everything looks good from my side, shall I submit it? Customer: Submit nothing yet. Part of me wants this, but I need my accountant to verify the tax angle first.
Agent: Our existing customers rate this plan 4.8 out of 5. Customer: Ratings do not matter much to me. My brother had a bad claim experience with you, so I am torn.
Agent: Is there anything holding you back from saying yes today? Customer: Only the paperwork bothers me, the product itself is perfect. If you handle the forms, I am in.
Agent: I can waive the first-year charges as a special case for you. Customer: That waiver helps, but I still need to compare with two other banks before I commit to anything.
Agent: Many first-time investors start exactly with this amount. Customer: I believe you, and I want to invest, but my emergency fund is empty right now so it feels risky.
Agent: Sir, may I explain our senior citizen deposit scheme? Customer: Proceed. Rate acceptable. Open account. Send details by post.
Agent: Madam, a quick word about our festival loan mela? Customer: No. Busy. Do not call again.

Agent: Good day, I am calling from the bank regarding your eligibility for a top-up loan. Customer: Oh wonderful, yes, I was actually just discussing a home renovation with my husband yesterday, so this call is quite well timed. Please tell me everything in detail, all the rates, the tenure options, every single charge, and then we can decide how to proceed further.
Agent: Only two minutes for the new child plan benefits? Customer: Hmm, okay tell quickly, but I am not promising anything, you know how these calls go, mostly I just listen and then forget about it.

Agent: Your account qualifies for a free locker facility this quarter. Customer: Arre, I told your colleague last month only, we are shifting our entire family banking to another bank. No need to offer anything now.
Agent: The EMI card is approved, should I dispatch it to your office? Customer: Haan, bhejo, bahut kaam aayega. Office address note kar lo, fourth floor, Cyber Hub.

Agent: I will cut to the chase, this fund doubles Loop. Customer: Look, whatever you say sounds fine on paper, only thing is I never take financial decisions over phone calls, as a rule. Send an email and maybe I will glance at it.
Agent: Just confirming your communication preferences for offers. Customer: Mark everything as declined. I do not want promotional communication through any channel whatsoever.
Agent: Before you go, our travel card has lifetime free lounge access. Customer: Stop calling me. Put my number on your do not call list right now.
Agent: This will only take a minute, I promise. Customer: I have asked three times already. Remove me from your calling list and do not contact me again.
Agent: Can I at least send the details over SMS? Customer: No messages, no calls, no emails. Unsubscribe me from everything immediately.
Agent: Sir, your feedback would really help us improve. Customer: My feedback is this: take me off your lists. I do not want to hear from your bank again.
Agent: The new rates are actually much better than before. Customer: I do not care about the rates. Stop contacting me, this is my final warning to you.
Agent: Would email be a better channel for these updates? Customer: No channel is better. Put me on the DNC list and confirm it by SMS once.
Agent: Are you above twenty years of age? Customer: Yes.
Agent: Can you hear me clearly, sir? Customer: Yeah.
Agent: Should I stop calling you about this offer? Customer: No.
Agent: I will send the brochure right away, okay? Customer: Okay.
Agent: So, what do you think about the proposal? Customer: Hmm.
Agent: Are you the right person for banking decisions? Customer: Yes, go ahead.
